product_one_liner.value: Plannerly is a cloud-based BIM management platform that helps architecture, engineering and construction professionals plan, manage and verify BIM projects.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains BIM-management guides, product content and industry education, rather than an engineering blog about building Plannerly.

public_docs.notes: The public help center includes multiple articles; the integrations collection alone lists five.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No identifiable Plannerly employer careers page or company-specific job board was found; the apparent careers URL showed general site content rather than vacancies.

model_provider.notes: OpenAI is listed as the subprocessor for optional AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page attributes ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 reports to infrastructure providers; Plannerly's own certification is still being prepared.

last_funding.notes: Caplight identifies an accelerator round on April 3, 2019 as the most recent round; no amount is disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly listed round is April 2019, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No identifiable Plannerly employer careers page or company-specific job board was found.

launched_6mo.notes: An official video published August 28, 2026 presents Plannerly's biggest update, including a new end-to-end workflow, mobile access and more than 50 further improvements.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete dated leadership roster or verifiable C-level/VP appointment or departure was found for the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public integrations index names BIM and AI connections, but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
